design: Resident quota redesign v0.6 + section 9, phase 1 (KooYomi Task 12ada80e). One row per failure code, with extra rows where the stage or the outcome reason changes the answer. Read by classify.mjs#failureRow; test/failure-table.test.mjs keeps it complete and consistent with the Source catalogue.
match: A failure is (stage, phase, code, outcome reason, diagnostic reason codes). Rows of the code apply when the stage is listed (or stages is any) and the phase matches (when given). Among them the most specific wins: reasons (the outcome reason is listed) > reasonCodesAny (a diagnostic code is listed) > reasonCodesWithin (every diagnostic code is listed, at least one) > no predicate; then a listed stage > any. A failure no row matches is unknown: HALT.

fields.class: not-admitted: Native said no to this head for now. waiting: Native said not yet (phase 2 waits for it). deterministic-pr: the PR itself makes this head fail again. unmapped-stage-1: a stage-1 refusal no row names. transient: an outside, passing condition. environment: this host or its services. clean-final: clean, but this head is done. queue: stage 8 did not reach the merge-queue head. abort: the Owner aborted. unknown: something may still run or a publication may be unsettled.
fields.disposition: release: close the reservation as NOT_EXECUTED, the head stays unburned. release-if-safe: release only when the bound stage outcome says safeToRerun (the Source's own flag) or the broker refused before any launch with the original restored, and only before 10-started; otherwise burn. burn: the head is burned (FAILED_CLEAN). halt: FAILED_UNKNOWN, burned, HALT until the Owner re-arms.
fields.retry: new-trigger: a later trigger may evaluate the same head again (10-minute cool-down, at most unexecutedMaxPer24h per head per day). attempt2: the one automatic attempt 2 when the failure is at stage 0, 1 or 2 before any role was published; later stages burn like new-commit. new-commit: only a new head of the PR runs. owner-rearm: the Owner re-arms the HALT.
fields.breaker: Phase 2 input, recorded now: counts = an environment failure the circuit breaker counts; neutral = caused by the PR, the claim or a wait, never counted.
